scenario.title: Lakeside Water — billing dispute surge (Mock #6, not an official contest problem)
scenario.description: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled in August-September. Customer Service wants an AI agent. Field reading is contracted out; AMI meters and the meter data management system (MDMS) are run by a vendor.
scenario.initial_request: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

potential_bias: frames the issue as a response-speed problem

H-REQUESTER-FRAME.statement: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

H-AMI-READ-FAILURE.statement: AMI meters are delivering missing or corrupted register reads to MDMS, leading to estimation substitution and incorrect bills.

H-FIELD-READ-DELAY.statement: Contracted manual meter reads are delayed or incorrectly recorded, causing missing reads and estimation errors in billing.

H-BILLING-RULE-ALTERATION.statement: A recent change to billing import validation rules (e.g., tariff or read-type mapping) introduced after August caused systematic bill miscalculations.

interpretation_history.interpretation: No tariff change records were found, indicating that recent tariff alterations are not present in the billing system logs.
The observation shows that among disputed bills, more have actual reads (1785) than estimated reads (1240), indicating that disputes are not primarily driven by estimation substitution.

Route completion for August‑September 2026 is 0.88, below the 0.95 target, indicating that manual meter‑read collection is lagging and may be contributing to estimation substitution and disputed bills.
Dispute ticket counts rose from ~600 in June/July to ~1,200 in August and September, indicating a doubling of dispute volume since August.

interpretation_history.interpretation: Shortage of three field readers since July causes routes to run late, leading to estimated bills for affected customers.
